jobs.title: Data Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Data Operations Manager The Opportunity:

You know that project managers touch every single part of a business and wear multiple hats, from caring for the client and their meaningful project goals to participating in business development and being a key contributor to their employees’ growth. We’re looking for someone like you to help our clients meet their mission by supporting national security.

The Data Operations Manager leads a team of data scientists, data engineers, and product owners, from planning and design to testing and deployment. This role balances technical guidance with project management to ensure software products are delivered on time, within budget, and to high quality standards. The manager establishes development standards and best practices, maintains code quality and system architecture, and acts as the key link between the development team and upper management.

Work with us to transform the future of digital platforms.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:
- 3+ years of experience with data governance
- 2+ years of experience managing and leading teams
- Experience with Agile methodologies and sprint planning tools
- Experience with data analytics and presenting findings to leadership
- Top Secret clearance
- HS diploma or GED

- Ability to lead and mentor across varied technical teams
- Ability to manage resource allocation, team workload, and project prioritization
- Ability to stay up to date with the latest software development and data management technologies and methodologies
- Possession of strong interpersonal and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration
- Possession of excellent project management skills
- TS/SCI clearance
- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field preferred; Master’s degree in a STEM field a plus
- PMP, AWS, ITIL, or CSM Certification
- Security+ CE Certification

jobs.title: Human Resources and Human Capital Program Manager
jobs.description:
Human Resources and Human Capital Program Manager The Opportunity:
An effective program requires a manager who is passionate about guiding it through the complexities of its lifecycle. It requires someone who is dedicated to identifying challenges, mitigating risks, and supporting a team with vision and focus. That’s why we need a seasoned program manager like you who can ensure our human resources (HR) or human capital program achieves success.

As a lead Human Resources and Human Capital Program Manager on our team, you’ll design, implement, and maintain impactful programs by guiding numerous efforts. Your customer will trust you to organize and coordinate program objectives, while your team will look to you for direction as they navigate requirements, budget constraints, and staffing challenges. As an authority in the National Security Sector, you’ll identify opportunities to grow the business by supporting your customer’s mission. You’ll also broaden your expertise in problem management, strategic planning, reviewing contracts, and more. This is your chance to impact national security programs while sharing your knowledge and expertise of program management methodologies.

jobs.description:
Cyber Security Program Manager The Opportunity:
As the Cyber Security Program Manager, you will lead enterprise-wide security initiatives, overseeing the development and execution of SOC strategies, governance frameworks, and operational processes. This role drives continuous improvement, measures performance, and partners with cross-functional teams to enhance the organization’s security posture and ensure seamless integration of security operations.

What You'll Work On:
- Lead the development and execution of a robust Security Operations Center (SOC) strategy and implementation roadmap, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and industry best practices.
- Design, establish, and sustain an Enterprise SOC (ESOC) governance framework to support effective oversight and risk management.
- Direct ESOC operations, driving continuous improvement and ensuring operational activities are integrated with organizational security goals.
- Implement and oversee ESOC performance measurement systems, tracking key metrics to inform decision-making and optimize outcomes.
- Conduct ongoing evaluations and effectiveness reviews of ESOC processes, leveraging insights to enhance security posture and operational maturity.
- Partner with cross-functional security teams to facilitate seamless integration of ESOC initiatives, promoting unified threat response and information sharing.

Join us. The world can't wait.

- Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, risk management, and project management

- Ability to develop and implement strategic initiatives that enhance SOC operations
- Ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- TS/SCI clearance

- CISSP, Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification

jobs.title: Emerging Technology Strategist Technical Lead
jobs.description:
Emerging Technology Strategist Technical Lead The Opportunity:
Develop, implement, and assess specific new and emerging technologies, platforms, and services. Apply leading-edge principles, theories, and concepts and contribute to the development of new principles and concepts. Work on unusually complex problems and provides highly innovative solutions.

As the Emerging Technologies Strategist Lead, you will lead research and architectural evaluation efforts to identify innovative solutions that support agency modernization. This role involves translating complex technical concepts, such as Artificial Intelligence, quantum computing, and edge architectures, into actionable insights for senior leadership. The primary focus is to ensure that technological integrations directly enhance core mission operations and address complex border security challenges through advanced infrastructure modernization.

What You'll Work On:
- Technology Strategy: Identify structured roadmaps that outlines how this Federal organization will deploy digital tools, infrastructure, and resources to achieve its overarching business goals and drive operational value.

- Technology Research: Conduct comprehensive research into emerging technologies, including agentic AI, multi-agent systems, and spatial computing, to evaluate their feasibility and benefit to agency operations.

- Content Development: Author technical white papers, architectural assessments, and strategic roadmaps that detail the potential impact of new solutions.

- Executive Briefings: Develop and deliver high-level briefings for senior leadership, providing clear, data-driven recommendations for technology adoption.

- Ad-Hoc Technical Support: Provide rapid-response analysis on complex, evolving technical topics and taskers as required by the mission.

- AI Governance: Assist in the development of frameworks for the ethical and effective governance of AI systems within the federal environment.

- Mission Alignment: Ensure all research and proposed technical integrations are strategically aligned with the goals of enhancing CBP infrastructure and mission effectiveness.

- Federal Compliance: Ensure all deliverables and research methodologies adhere to federal standards, security protocols, and documentation requirements.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:
- Experience designing solutions at an Enterprise-level, utilizing emerging technologies

- Experience researching, assessing, and evaluating emerging technologies, including AI, Edge Computing, Sensor, or Computer Vision

- Experience with technical writing and producing white papers, decks, and strategic reports for government or enterprise clients

Mission Technology Lab Operations Manager The Opportunity:
The Lab Operations Administrator is a core technical contributor and operator within a multidomain cyber and engineering lab environment. This role combines hands‑on infrastructure administration with solution development, automation engineering, and cross‑functional coordination to ensure the lab remains secure, resilient, operationally ready, and aligned with mission and client objectives. You will bring a strong technical foundation, the ability to design and automate cyber workflows, and the judgement to work independently on moderately complex tasks while contributing to broader capability development.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:
- Experience with modern compute and networking environments, including administering and troubleshooting virtualization platforms, network security devices, operating systems, databases, and cloud services
- Experience with enterprise‑grade monitoring, asset visibility, configuration management, and security platforms
- Experience supporting capability development and demonstration environments, and coordinating across teams and stakeholders to support aligned, efficient, and collaborative project execution
- Knowledge of compliance frameworks for extended enterprise environments such as SP 800‑53 Rev. 5, including vulnerability management, patch cycles, and configuration baselines
- Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows operating systems
- Ability to manage technical documentation such as inventories, slick sheets, access lists, dependency maps, and configuration artifacts, and quickly learn mission‑specific tools
- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for broad audiences
- Secret clearance
- Bachelor’s degree
- Security+ certification

Nice If You Have:
- Experience with agile workflows, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices such as Ansible, Kubernetes, or GitHub Enterprise, and automation efforts supporting modernization
- Experience with configuration and asset tracking platforms for network infrastructure devices and related systems
- Possession of strong written and verbal communication skills
- Cloud certifications

Clearance:
Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

jobs.description:
Digital Transformation Specialist The Opportunity:
As a digital transformation professional, you know that implementing improved digital initiatives with effective project and change management is cru cia l for your client’s future. You’re eager to apply your experience and Navy knowledge to develop creative solutions. We’re looking for someone like you to apply your knowledge and help organizations solve their traditional business challenges with new digital strategies and solutions.

You will guide users through Power Apps and other low-code platforms, ensuring they are equipped to leverage digital tools effectively. Your written and verbal communication skills will help you gather user insights and create clear, user-focused communications, documentation, and training materials.

You will plan and facilitate User Acceptance Testing ( UAT ) , capture feedback, and support smooth deployment and user readiness. Your ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders will ensure clear understanding and adoption. Working collaboratively, you will create and coordinate digital solutions in a fast-paced environment with multiple competing priorities, always seeking opportunities for process improvement and innovation across the enterprise.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

- Experience guiding users through low‑code solutions such as Power Apps
- Experience gathering user insights and creating clear, user‑focused communications, documentation, and training materials
- Experience planning and facilitating UAT, capturing feedback, and supporting smooth deployment and user readiness

- Ability to create and coordinate digital solutions as part of a collaborative team and perform in a fast-paced work environment with multiple competing priorities

Digital Transformation Specialist The Opportunity:
We are looking for someone who has a passion for Agile and knowledge management to support a digital transformation effort with our Navy customers within established Agile frameworks. If you're eager to apply your experience as an Agilist and have a passion for information sciences and knowledge management, then this role is for you.

The digital transformation specialist will support in two key areas. First, you'll work closely with our government stakeholders to modernize and create efficiencies within enterprise operations by implementing strategies for enterprise software solutions, automation, data management frameworks, and human-centered experience design. Using data analysis, technical requirement definition, workflow mapping, and platform configuration, you’ll work closely with key stakeholders and other technical professionals to develop and contribute to transformative business systems, processes, and digital solutions. ​

Second, you'll directly work with our community of practice to support our Agile ceremonies, enable smooth workflows, provide onboarding and training, and implement major process and people efforts across engineering and program level teams.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:
- Experience with Agile frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban

- Knowledge of knowledge bases such as Confluence and SharePoint

Business Development Manager, Senior The Opportunity:
Build and grow Booz Allen’s advanced cyber R&D business, working at the front end of emerging research to turn difficult cyber problems into new programs and opportunities.

As a Senior Business Development Manager, you’ll develop opportunities with advanced U.S. government R&D organizations working on some of the hardest problems in cybersecurity. You’ll work directly with government program managers, Booz Allen technical leaders, and external research partners to identify emerging needs, shape research opportunities, and develop competitive technical approaches.

The work spans advanced cyber research, including secure and resilient systems, AI-enabled cyber capabilities, cyber-physical systems, and emerging computing technologies. You’ll bring together researchers, technologists, and partners around problems that often require capabilities no single organization has on its own.

You’ll have significant ownership in shaping where we compete and how the cyber R&D business grows. This is an opportunity to build rather than inherit, so you’ll develop new sponsor relationships, shape opportunities, form the teams and approaches behind them, and remain directly involved through pursuit and award as you build the team.

- Build a qualified cyber R&D pipeline by developing sponsor relationships, identifying emerging research needs, and shaping new opportunities.
- Lead opportunities from early sponsor engagement through capture, teaming, proposal development, and award.
- Work with technical leaders and researchers to develop credible approaches to complex cyber problems and turn them into compelling research concepts and pursuit strategies.
- Build teams across Booz Allen and external research and technology organizations around the capabilities each pursuit requires.
- Assess customer needs, technical approaches, competitive dynamics, and teaming options to recommend where to invest, how to compete, and when to stop.
- Write sponsor briefings, whitepapers, and key proposal content.
- Build and lead a small cyber R&D business development team while remaining directly involved in the work.

jobs.description:
Compliance Director The Opportunity:
Booz Allen is looking for an experienced compliance leader to help shape how our compliance capability supports a business evolving across technology, government missions, partnerships, acquisitions, and new ways of delivering for customers.

As Director, Compliance, you will oversee an experienced team responsible for a portfolio of compliance and integrity programs and shape how Legal, Ethics & Compliance (LEC) identifies, assesses, and responds to compliance risk. You will advise the Chief Ethics & Compliance Officer (CECO) and other leaders on complex matters, changing risks, and where action is needed.

You will also connect specialized compliance programs across LEC that sit with different leaders, creating a shared view of compliance risk and program effectiveness while preserving each program leader’s accountability and expertise. You will bring those perspectives together, challenge whether risks and issues are being addressed appropriately, and surface matters that require action across programs or leadership attention.

This role offers the opportunity to lead complex compliance work, influence decisions across the business, advise executives, and evolve our approach to compliance. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizenship is required.

What You'll Do:
- Set priorities for the Compliance capability within LEC and advance how we identify, manage, and assess compliance risk.
- Oversee a portfolio of compliance programs, including anti-corruption, third-party integrity, government contractor compliance, conflicts of interest, competition, lobbying, and related areas, with experienced program leaders providing subject-matter leadership for their programs.
- Guide and challenge compliance program leaders on complex matters, changing risks, program priorities, and issues requiring action or escalation.
- Lead the compliance risk assessment, using input from across Compliance, changes in the business and regulatory environment, investigations, audits, monitoring, and other evidence to identify changing exposure, gaps, and priorities.
- Strengthen how compliance programs are evaluated and improved, using evidence and outcomes to identify root causes, address gaps, and improve program effectiveness.
- Advise on compliance risk as the business changes, including new offerings, partnerships, acquisitions, and regulatory developments, working with Legal, business, and functional leaders to address risks early.
- Maintain a connected view across Compliance, identifying shared risks and issues, challenging whether they are being appropriately addressed, and surfacing matters requiring broader action or CECO attention.
- Advise the CECO and executive leadership and support Audit Committee engagement on compliance risk, program effectiveness, open issues and remediation, emerging risks, and priorities requiring leadership attention.

Join us. The world can't wait.

Enterprise Cybersecurity GRC Governance Analyst The Opportunity:
The Enterprise Cybersecurity (ECS) Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is seeking an experienced Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to bridge the gap between high-level policy and technical execution. In this role, you will analyze and translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable enterprise guidance, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and technical standards. Leveraging a strong foundation in business process and change management, you will act as a key liaison to gather comprehensive business and security requirements, ensuring enterprise workflows are optimized and automated before being embedded into technical tools. A central focus of this role is identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and optimize GRC processes to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance compliance outcomes across the organization.

You will apply configuration management expertise to design, configure, and mature workflows within GRC tools—specifically ServiceNow—while actively facilitating technical integrations with external ticketing, reporting, and workflow systems. By taking a process-first approach, you will champion the automation of system security planning, Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) tracking, and evidence collection across the enterprise, continuously seeking ways to optimize and digitize routine tasks. This position is ideal for an analytical, independent professional who can design end-to-end compliance architectures, align stakeholders, and drive consistent, scalable, and automated GRC execution across a rapidly evolving enterprise landscape. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizenship is required.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:
- 8+ years of experience in roles including Security Control Assessor (SCA), Validator, Information System Security Officer (ISSO), Information System Security Engineer (ISSE), or Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)

- Experience leading business process and change management initiatives, designing and modernizing workflows for authorization, POA&M tracking, and audit evidence collection to drive agility and reduce risk across the organization

- Experience in configuring, optimizing, and automating Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platforms, such as ServiceNow, Archer, Xacta, eMASS) to enhance System Security Plan (SSP) development, risk assessment, and control mapping processes

- Experience translating complex security and policy requirements into innovative technical documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), implementation guidance, and enterprise standards, to support continuous process improvement and modernization

The right mixture of great ideas and funding can create change. In a complex organization, allocating funding to where it can be most effective can be challenging. As a federal acquisition management professional at Booz Allen, you will apply your knowledge and expertise in the Warfighting Acquisition System (WAS) to advance the National Defense Strategy and support client strategic goals and mission. jobs.description:
Assessments, Monitoring, and Evaluation Program Analyst The Opportunity:
Are you passionate about helping organizations successfully implement change and advance their operations? Whether it’s process improvement, performance measurement, or business management analysis, it comes down to one thing: learning how an organization works and making it better. Although many companies know where they want to go, getting there can be a challenge. Tha nk fully, that’s what you do, improve the systems that move entire organizations forward. It’s why we’re looking for someone like you—an Assessments, Monitoring, and Evaluation (AM&E) Program Analyst who can identify long term goals and create the processes needed to achieve them.

This is an opportunity to create efficiency in the DoD. As an AM&E Program Analyst, you’ll use your expertise to assess how alterations will impact business processes and design to develop assessment development, data collection and analysis. From unrealized potential to systemic challenges, you’ll provide your client with a holistic view of their organization to transform their practices for the better.

Work with us as we lead change in the DoD.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

- 10+ years of experience working with U.S. government or military entities

- 3+ years of experience with DoD security cooperation or security assistance programs

- Experience working with both Department of State and Department of Defense End-Use Monitoring (EUM) compliance programs, such as Golden Sentry or Blue Lantern, and coordinating across military components and geographic combatant commands

- Experience developing and presenting briefings, reports, and recommendations to senior military leadership, including General Officers or Flag Officers

jobs.title: Threat Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
Threat Finance Analyst The Opportunity :
Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security?

Never has the role of a Threat Finance Analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data – it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thi nk ing and flexibility, you quickly seek out the accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security.

As a Threat Finance Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission environment. You’ll validate the information and apply client tradecraft as you build assessments for senior policy makers. This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our policy makers.

Join us. The world can't wait.

- Experience in threat finance analysis, transnational organized crime analysis, or counter-drug analysis

- Experience with providing operational counter-drug intelligence support both to DoD elements performing drug detection and monitoring missions and to U.S. and international law enforcement agencies involved in drug interdiction missions

- Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policy makers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Specialist, Lead
jobs.description:
Trade Compliance Specialist, Lead The Opportunity:
In this role, you will apply deep expertise in export classifications and regulatory frameworks, including EAR and ITAR, to guide the full lifecycle of export and import compliance from product design through delivery. You will lead the intake and evaluation of product reviews for trade compliance inquiries, provide clear and actionable guidance on product classifications, and support license determinations that ensure alignment with complex regulatory requirements. Acting as a key owner of enterprise-wide trade compliance processes, you will build, refine, and maintain robust protocols that help safeguard the organization’s obligations in a rapidly evolving regulatory landscape.

You will partner closely with business units and program teams to operationalize trade control requirements and embed them into daily activities, ensuring regulatory considerations are built into workflows from the outset. Success in this role hinges on your ability to serve as a collaborative, relationship‑oriented advisor who strengthens internal controls, drives awareness, and empowers teams to uphold compliance responsibilities with confidence. By translating complex export regulations into practical, digestible guidance, you will enable internal clients to understand and own their obligations while reinforcing a strong, consistent compliance culture across the enterprise. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizen ship is required .

What You’ll Do
- Assist senior staff in develop ing exportability guidance to meet business needs as assigned
- Ensure program managers and internal clients receive necessary execution guidance and understand their export control responsibilities
- Classify products, sof tware, and solutions for export purposes, with spe cia lized expertise in encryption-controlled items under EAR and ITAR
- Maintain export license files and records in the compliance database to accurately reflect current status
- Review and research export compliance issues raised by the business or senior management, and provide background analysis and recommendations for further action
- Provide analytical support for the develop ment, implementation, and continuous improvement of the international trade compliance program, policies , and procedures.
- Help with spe cia l projects and other departmental responsibilities, as assigned

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:
- 5+ years of experience in export controls, with focus in classifying products, sof tware, or services for export
- Experience building collaborative relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and influencing adoption of compliance controls across various organizational roles
- Experience using Micro sof t products, including Excel and SharePoint
- Ability to analyze, research, and assess international trade regulations
- Ability to establish, manage, and continuously improve trade compliance processes and protocols within an enterprise environment
- Ability to be diplomatic, exercise sound judgment and discretion, and show initiative
- Ability to work independently while also e nga ging effectively across teams ; flexible in prioritizing and managing competing tasks
- Bachelor’s degree

Nice If You Have :

jobs.title: Defensive Cyber Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Defensive Cyber Operations Analyst The Opportunity:
As a cyberspace defender on our team, you’ll be in the middle of the action, monitoring real-time threats, analyzing complex cyber events, and helping protect mission‑critical networks that support operations. Every alert, anomaly, or suspicious pattern you uncover helps ensure the uninterrupted flow of information that commanders and warfighters rely on.

We need a Defensive Cyberspace Operations (DCO) Analyst like you to help safeguard enterprise‑level systems against cyber threats targeting Combatant Command Headquarters, Service Components, Joint Task Forces, and mission partners. As a DCO analyst, you’ll monitor and analyze threats using advanced tools, including Assured Compliance Assessment Solution, Splunk, Host‑Based Security System, and Big Data Platform capabilities like SIGACT and RALLY. You’ll use your cyber defense tradecraft to identify malicious activity, distinguish real threats from benign events, and escalate incidents with clear summaries of impact and urgency.

You’ll combine threat intelligence, event data, and correlation across multiple sources to uncover attacker patterns and understand their goals, stopping them before they succeed. You’ll work alongside teammates conducting uninterrupted DCO, Computer Network Defense, Information Assurance, and NetOps to maintain situational awareness and ensure secure, available IT C4 systems.

Your work will include supporting DCO event and incident response, documenting and escalating cyber events, performing multi‑source correlation, and producing daily reporting that enhances commander awareness. You’ll also coordinate with enterprise‑wide cyber defense partners, respond to CPCON changes, assist with operational briefs, and help implement proactive and reactive security measures that protect Combatant Command networks. You’ll even leverage Department of War AI capabilities to strengthen defensive cyberspace operations.

This is a great opportunity to build hands‑on skills in threat detection, incident response, and cyber event analysis while contributing directly to missions vital to homeland defense. Work with us as we secure critical networks from malicious actors.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

- Experience supporting DCO within a shift work-based 24x7 operations center
- Experience advising on network security issues and enforcing vulnerability mitigation policies and procedures
- Experience developing reports, presenting daily network security summaries, and communicating clearly with senior leaders and varied audiences
- Experience with customer queries and reviewing data for component units
- Knowledge of management and monitoring of network security components, devices, and services
- Knowledge of cybersecurity tools such as Splunk, HBSS, Microsoft Defender, or Security Onion
- Ability to support Panama Schedule DCO Watch Stander shifts, holidays, and weekends on an as‑needed basis
- TS/SCI clearance
- HS diploma or GED and 2+ years of experience conducting DCO, SOC, JCC, or NOSC mission operations, or Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of experience conducting DCO, SOC, JCC, or NOSC mission operations
- Security+ or DoDM 8140.03 Certification

Nice If You Have:

- Experience developing or delivering cyberspace operations support at the Combatant Command or Major Command level
- Knowledge of AI in the performance of DCO operations
- Knowledge of cybersecurity and cyberspace operations doctrine, Joint Publications, and policy implementation
- Knowledge of implementing security patching across enterprise systems
- Ability to formulate recommendations for corrective actions that address identified risks and support JCC operations

Perform a lead role supporting Booz Allen’s Contractor Business Systems compliance function, with primary focus on the Accounting, Estimating, Procurement, and Government Property systems. jobs.title: FMS Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
FMS Financial Analyst The Opportunity:
Are you looking for an opportunity to use your financial management and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) expertise to support some of the Department of War's most complex international programs? As an FMS Financial Analyst, you'll help manage the financial execution of advanced defense capabilities that strengthen interoperability between the United States and its international partners.

In this role, you'll work alongside government program managers, technical teams, foreign partners, and industry partners to support the development and execution of FMS cases involving complex Naval capabilities. You'll apply your knowledge of the FMS process and Navy acquisition environment to coordinate financial requirements across program stakeholders, develop and maintain spend plans, analyze case execution, and ensure financial data remains accurate across enterprise systems.

You'll provide the financial insight needed to help program leadership understand case performance, identify execution challenges, and make informed decisions. From developing financial forecasts and reconciling case data to supporting program and financial management reviews, your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of critical capabilities to U.S. international partners.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

- 7+ years of experience with financial management, program financial analysis, budgeting, or funds execution for Department of War programs
- Experience supporting Navy acquisition programs at the program office level, including organizations such as PEO C4I, NAVWAR, or NAVSEA
- Experience developing and maintaining program financial management products such as execution spend plans, obligation and expenditure phasing plans, or financial forecasts
- Experience analyzing financial execution data such as commitments, obligations, expenditures, or disbursements and identifying and resolving discrepancies
- Experience developing financial reports, executive summaries, and recommendations to support program leadership and recurring or ad hoc financial data calls
- Experience supporting program and case execution reviews such as Financial Management Reviews (FMRs), Case Reconciliation Reviews (CRRs), or Program Management Reviews (PMRs)
- Experience using FMS and Navy enterprise systems, including DSAMS, SCIP, MISIL, N-ERP, or SCES
- Ability to collaborate with case managers, program offices, financial managers, technical stakeholders, and industry partners to resolve complex financial and programmatic issues

- Bachelor's degree

- Experience developing or maintaining FMS case documentation across Pre-LOR, Case Development, Case Execution, and Case Closure activities

The right mixture of great ideas and funding can create change. In a complex organization, allocating funding to where it can be most effective can be challenging. jobs.title: Supply Chain SME and Humanitarian Response Logistics Lead
jobs.description:
Supply Chain SME and Humanitarian Response Logistics Lead The Opportunity:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Subject Matter Expert to support an FDA initiative to improve supply chain resilience for medical devices. Specifically, this role will serve to support strategic efforts to improve supply chain visibility and oversee risk management of health commodities marketed and sold in the US. In particular, this position will emphasize humanitarian logistics and experience with infectious disease commodity management. The successful candidate will provide specialist expertise in supply chain, logistics, and operational preparedness for public health and humanitarian response programs.

You will help design and optimize resilient, agile supply chain solutions that inform government and industry stakeholders as well as provide improved visibility into supply chains for critical medical devices and other emergent healthcare settings. You will work across multidisciplinary teams to strengthen resource mobilization, build and improve risk management principles across the Program to not only identify potential supply chain disruptions but also help assess potential programmatic impact in areas such as: inventory availability, production, downstream logistics, upstream supply availability, and demand planning.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:
- 7+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, humanitarian operations, or public health field, including health supply chain management
- Experience designing, developing, and implementing end-to-end health supply chain solutions in complex  or emergency environments
- Experience supporting infectious disease or outbreak response teams, including logistics planning, resource mobilization, operational coordination, and emergency preparedness
- Experience contributing to supply chain risk management, operational readiness, risk assessment, or risk identification activities within health, humanitarian, or emergency-response settings
- Experience coordinating health supply chain activities across cross-functional, international, governmental, non-governmental, or multi-agency teams
- Experience using data, analytics, and technology platforms to improve supply chain visibility, tracking, forecasting, and performance in health or humanitarian contexts
- Knowledge of inventory management, procurement, warehousing, distribution, transportation, and last-mile delivery, preferably for medicines, medical commodities, personal protective equipment, laboratory supplies, or health-related products
- Knowledge of compliance, safety, regulatory, quality, and infection prevention requirements relevant to infectious disease and health logistics
- Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements
- Bachelor’s degree

Nice If You Have:
- Experience supporting Ebola response operations, including outbreak logistics, infection prevention requirements, personal protective equipment, medical commodities, or high-risk deployment environments
- Experience working with regulatory agencies for medical devices
- Experience working with national governments, humanitarian organizations, public health agencies, or international response mechanisms
- Experience with infectious disease preparedness, outbreak protocols, and supply chain challenges in resource-constrained settings
- Experience with warehouse or logistics management information systems, emergency operations platforms, or cloud-based supply chain tools
- Experience supporting data governance, quality assurance, asset cataloging, metadata management, traceability, and reporting
- Ability to explain complex supply chain issues to non-technical audiences
- Possession of excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

jobs.description:
Operations Manager The Opportunity:
When an organization has multiple moving parts in its processes, it can be difficult to critically examine them. To be more efficient and effective, it needs a business process specialist to learn its business and mission end-to-end and provide ways to change for the better. That’s why we need you, an experienced business process specialist who knows how to analyze every aspect of your customer’s operations and give them the steps to improve their process.

As the Operations Manager on our team, you’ll analyze your client’s current operating environment and identify areas for improvement. You’ll facilitate discussions with leadership and support staff to help refine the client’s definition of success and identify current frustrations. You’ll design data collection plans, facilitate workshops, and communicate your research and illustrative analysis using root cause analysis, SIPOC charts, fishbone diagrams, failure mode effect analyses, trend analysis, and future state models to help establish understanding and agreement from key stakeholders.

Work with us as we help the client evolve.

What You’ll Work On:
- Develop and maintain integrated master schedules for training exercises, workshops, and capability demonstrations.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams, including instructional designers, logistics specialists, and subject-matter experts.
- Track program metrics, prepare status reports, and brief senior leadership on performance and risk.
- Identify operational risks, implement mitigation strategies, and update the program risk register.
- Lead continuous process improvement initiatives to optimize resource use and streamline PMO workflows.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

- 7+ years of experience in IT operations, technical operations, or systems administration, including coordinating operational activities
- 3+ years of experience leading technical teams, assigning responsibilities, managing workloads, and ensuring successful completion of operational objectives
- Experience supporting enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, virtualization technologies, cloud environments, and associated systems
- Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining operational procedures, schedules, and processes to ensure mission readiness and service continuity
- Experience identifying, troubleshooting, escalating, and resolving technical and operational issues while minimizing disruptions to business or mission-critical systems

jobs.description:

Are you looking for an opportunity to combine your technical skills with big picture thinking to make an impact in the Army, Navy, and USMC market? You understand your customer’s environment and how to develop the right systems for their mission. Your ability to translate real-world needs into technical specifications makes you an integral part of delivering a customer focused engineering solution.

On our team, you’ll be able to broaden your skillset into areas like AI, Data Platforms, Autonomy, Networks, Undersea, and communications at the edge. jobs.title: Data and Artificial Intelligence Policy and Governance Analyst
jobs.description:
Data and Artificial Intelligence Policy and Governance Analyst The Opportunity:
For an organization to transform in today’s digital world, it needs to properly collect, store, and organize its data. Effective data management can enable more efficient operations, yielding more growth. As a data architect, you know how to apply your creative-thinking and analytical mindset to help organizations manage their data assets. We’re looking for an experienced data architect to apply their data architect knowledge and skills sets to support the creation and refinement of the Navy's AI and Data Policy and Governance structure.

As a Data and Artificial Intelligence Policy Governance Analyst for the Navy, you’ll use your extensive technical expertise to supports the planning, development, implementation, and oversight of Navy data and AI initiatives, including policy, governance, cloud migration, data-center compliance, and enterprise implementation efforts.

In this role, you’ll grow your Project management skillsets, apply best practices and use tools like Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

With your drive to establish Data and AI processes and governance, you’ll make a lasting impact on the Navy.

What You’ll Work On:
- Coordinate project execution by tracking milestones, risk and deliverables and maintain integrated roadmaps and support cloud migration and data-management initiatives.
- Facilitate the development and implementation of the Navy's data and AI policies, ensuring strict alignment with Department of Navy and Department of War Chief Data and AI Office Strategies.
- Plan and lead Data and AI Governance forums, working groups, and stakeholder meetings and document decisions and coordinate stakeholder participation in AI initiatives.
- Prepare senior-level briefs and decision materials while managing collaboration repositories and collaboratives workspaces using M365 tools.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:
- Experience supporting project, program, portfolio, or organizational-management activities
- Experience with data management, data governance, artificial intelligence, cloud migration, digital modernization, or related enterprise IT initiatives
- Experience with the Microsoft 365 environment, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
- Ability to develop concise executive briefings, status reports, and meeting materials
- Secret clearance
- HS diploma or GED

- Experience with project management
- Experience with Power Apps

- Bachelor’s degree
